Coomaraswamy’s survey of the Indian crafts, metalwork, textiles, ivory, wood, pottery and jewellery, with the village craftsman’s tradition and 220 illustrations (London, 1913). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The arts & crafts of India & Ceylon · Coomaraswamy, Ananda Kentish, 1877-1947 · 1913, 400 scanned pages. Published 1913; Ananda K. Coomaraswamy died 1947; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
